meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Genuine 2025+ foreign buy-side demand is MODERATE but narrow: it clusters almost entirely in one commodity niche — polythene/PE refuse & recycling sacks and caddy liners bought by GOVERNMENT/MUNICIPAL waste procurement (UK councils via Find a Tender, South African municipalities via etenders.gov.za, and EU/Norway via TED). That segment is well-documented and repeatable (councils re-tender annually). For actual 'plastic parts/components' and broader PE packaging outside bin-liners, public demand is THIN and low-quality — only gated, unverifiable B2B RFQ boards (TradeKey) with generic one-line leads. Best real, contactable opportunities: UK Find-a-Tender and South African etenders municipal refuse-bag tenders. DROPPED: Trash CAN International LTD (China) — generic 'Plastic Bags 20t', unverifiable entity, gated contact; Dacorum Borough Council — product is COMPOSTABLE/bio-based (not PE) and already a closed award; SRIYAAN creators (India) — generic 'Plastic parts', masked contact, unverifiable.
